scope_note: Every value carries a scope. 'global' means the figure is not specific to Australia: a worldwide list price or benchmark, shown in AUD. 'australia' means it is about Australia: in Phase 1, deployments in Australia as the gateways list them. Nothing is yet measured from Australia.

fx.description: A$1 = USD, RBA 4pm Sydney representative rate. AUD = USD / aud_usd.

attribution.used_for: Intelligence Index and cost per Intelligence Index task
Model prices, providers and open-weights status

points.definition: List price per 1M tokens in AUD: input, output and a 3:1 input:output blend. Global USD list price converted at the RBA daily rate, ex GST. The list price is Vercel AI Gateway's model price; for models not on Vercel, OpenRouter's with any discount removed; for models on neither, Artificial Analysis's. cheapest_available is the lowest price actually charged by any provider on either gateway for a full-precision deployment (FP8 or better, or no quantization stated), with its source. cheapest_quantized is the same for quantized deployments, with the quantization labelled.
Output tokens per second measured from Australia.
Spend on the model by Australian users.
What Australians use: share of Australian token volume.
Time to first token measured from Australia.

Artificial Analysis's cost per Intelligence Index task (weighted average cost per task, USD), converted to AUD at the RBA daily rate. Artificial Analysis's own figure, from its beta API (artificial_analysis_intelligence_index_cost.cost_per_task.total_cost). Each value's source says whether it came from the API or, as a fallback, was read off Artificial Analysis's chart by hand.
Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, whether the weights are open, and rank among open models.
Intelligence Index points per A$1 of blended token price per 1M tokens, for models scoring 30 or more. Higher is better value. Based on token price, not cost per task.
Open versus closed model share of usage.

Providers serving the model from Australia, as the gateways list them: Vercel AI Gateway deployments in an Australian cloud region, at that region's price, and OpenRouter providers that list an Australian datacenter (OpenRouter does not say which datacenter serves a request, so this is weaker evidence). Prices in AUD, ex GST. vs_list_price compares the cheapest Australian deployment with the model's list price. A count of 0 means neither gateway lists an Australian deployment; the model may still be available in Australia directly from a cloud provider. Null where the model is on neither gateway or provider data was not fetched.
Whether the model can be run inside Australia.

definitions.dominance: A dominates B when A is at least as smart and no dearer, and better on one of the two. Intelligence is compared in whole points, as Artificial Analysis's chart displays it; the stored scores keep their decimals.
definitions.frontier: Models that no other model dominates.
definitions.cheapest_per_intelligence_level: The cheapest model scoring at or above each level.
definitions.all_models: Every model with a score and a cost.
definitions.available_models: Only models listed on Vercel AI Gateway or OpenRouter.
definitions.australian_hosted_models: Only models a gateway lists as deployed in Australia (point 10). Costs are the same global figures as the other views; the Australian deployment can cost more, see providers_in_australia.vs_list_price.

by_cost_per_task.x: Artificial Analysis cost per Intelligence Index task, AUD
by_cost_per_task.y: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. Stored with the API's decimals; compared in whole points.

by_token_price.x: List price per 1M tokens, AUD, 3:1 input:output blend. Not cost per task: it ignores how many tokens a model spends on a task, so it ranks models differently from the main map.
by_token_price.y: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. Stored with the API's decimals; compared in whole points.
